verdict.rationale: Eqvista's round-modeling feature documents dilution from new investments, a new option pool, pre/post-money and investment-amount inputs, and a downloadable PDF of the analysis to share with stakeholders. A community user corroborates that round modeling exists. SAFEs can be added to the cap table and there is a note-conversion help article, but SAFE conversion inside the round model is not documented, and pro-forma ownership output is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit SAFE conversion within round modeling, documented pro-forma ownership table, sharing beyond a PDF export (e.g. live scenario links for counsel/investors), independent hands-on depth.

support.subject: As a founder, I can model a priced round — dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership — and share the scenario with counsel and investors

citations.quote: view the dilution of the company's cap table with the introduction of new investments. This round modeling financial analysis also takes into consideration a new option pool
Multiple inputs for date of investment, pre-money & post-money valuation, and investment amount
you can get a downloadable PDF file of the analysis that can be easily shared to all important stakeholders of your company
add SAFEs directly to your cap table when you are ready to raise
